verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing docs show transaction-level reconciliation (captures, refunds, partial/over-captures tied back to card and purchase) and bank funding/balance access, which cover pieces of the ledger-settlement story, but there's no evidence of a dedicated finance-lead dashboard for real-time balance views or penny-accurate settlement reports. missing for 10: explicit real-time balance dashboard for finance leads, formal settlement/reconciliation reporting (e.g., daily settlement files or GL export), and independent confirmation that reconciliation is accurate 'to the penny'.
